title: Chapter 600
paragraphs: Chapter 600
Episode 156. Chaos Purification (4)
"Do you mean, continue?"
"But, Brother O-Two-Wang said the machine is complete..."
Ban did not immediately respond but remained silent for a few seconds. With his blazing hair and deep, tranquil gaze, the Two-Wang brothers had no choice but to stand up straight.
All of the Myung-Wang clans quickly bowed their heads in respect.
Although there is no hierarchy between the Two-Wang and the regular warriors, Tushin Ban was indeed the absolute leader of the Myung-Wang clan.
Jin took his place among the regular warriors, observing the situation.
Then, Tantel and Shaku pushed Jin forward, to the place of the Two-Wang brothers.
'Stand at the front, brother!'
'But I'm not a Two-Wang?'
'Hurry up.'
And the same thing happened even after he stood next to the Two-Wang brothers.
'Stand next to Brother Ban!'
'Next to Tushin? Is that okay?'
'You inherited Sigmund, didn't you? You're the sole successor of the Tushin brothers. So, you rank even higher than us.'
With no other choice, Jin stood next to Ban. Only then did she open her mouth, as if the alignment was finally in order.
"You've become lazy, brothers."
"Tushin, we showed our unworthiness. Please guide us."
"It seems everyone has forgotten."
Ban pointed to Jin.
"Here, Brother Jin promised on the first day we found Lafrarosa that he would bring us out. Then, what should I and the brothers prepare for?"
"To support Brother Jin."
"That's right."
Rumble...!

Suddenly, the entire training ground began to resonate and vibrate with Ban's energy. The Two-Wang brothers felt a momentary darkness before their eyes, and the regular warriors clenched their teeth to keep from falling.
Jin was not affected by her energy at all. This was because Ban did not radiate her energy towards where he was standing.
"My heyday is over, and our glorious era also met its end half a million years ago."
Even as she spoke, her energy continued to intensify. As it grew stronger, the vibrations shaking the training ground became weaker. However, Ban's energy was a quiet storm.
"Tranquil, storm. As if these two completely opposite words have been combined, her energy contained a divine majesty.
'It's not because of the hierarchy that they aren't resisting. All of the brothers... they are genuinely overwhelmed by the momentum.'
The strongest warriors that Jin knew of.

He wondered if the likes of Temar and Syron Runecandle, who he encountered in the Mitra Desert, and even Ron Hylan, could possibly do this. Against a whopping twelve Two-Wangs and 64 members of the Myung-Wang clan.
"Even if we all can go out, it means that we can only show a power that is shamefully weak compared to those days to Brother Jin. With just that, can we protect Brother Jin, each other?"
'I think that would be enough to protect... ' Although he wanted to reply like this, Jin remained silent.
Ban released her energy.
The members of the Myung-Wang clan, catching their breath, all shouted in unison, 'No!'
"From now on, not only Brother Jin but all other brothers should train to the death, and train again. There should not be even one brother showing complacency, reminiscing about the old glory."
"We will keep that in mind, Tushin!"
The warning excluded Jin, not because Ban wanted to favor him. Because the next one to continue the spar was none other than Jin.
"Tushin."
When the Eleven-Two-Wang 'Nata' spoke, Ban met her gaze.
"Speak."
"First, I apologize once again for showing our shortcomings. But if we continue training like this, Brother Jin might be in danger, even if the other brothers aren't."
"Do the other brothers think the same?"
"Yes, Tushin. We may feel fatigued, but in fact, we are worried about the state of Brother Jin. If we continue to train..."
"He could die?"
"Yes."
"It seems my brothers have become more lax than I thought, given the absurdity of what you're saying."
"I'm sorry."
"Training is, inherently, something that could lead to death."
The Myung-Wang clan members closed their mouths again at Ban's words, spoken with emphasis on every single one.
Looking back, Tushin Ban has never hesitated to make Jin stronger by radical means, ever since he first came to Lafrarosa.
She proceeded with the transfusion of Tushin blood, keeping in mind that death was a possibility to some extent.
Like many great warriors, she believed that transcendence could not be achieved without risking one's life."

"From the outset, the training of the Myung-Wang clan was more aggressive and dangerous than any martial arts group in history. The reason they reigned as losers of fate was not just because they were a naturally born warrior race.

"Baltirok, Lumora, Pallem, Linpa, Boras, Dalphir, Belize, Garmund, Baba, Kaio, Nata, Teto. In the order they became Two-Wangs, have them spar with Brother Jin from the beginning. I will suppress any rampages, and those waiting for their turn should pair up and warm up."
"Hmm, Tushin? I think I need to look at the device a little more..."
"Didn't you say it was completed?"

"The training will get intense, so I think we should also prepare for treating the brothers. I won't need to use the special bonding technique. Since I would be out, making it eleven Two-Wangs, it would be good for the remaining ten to pair up two by two when one is sparring with Brother Jin, right?"
"Then let's start training with everyone except Brother Boras. Even the plain soldiers should form groups."
Boras chuckled and wished his brothers good luck.
Another two days passed.
Jin's consciousness flickered on and off like a magic lamp, and the rest of the Myung-Wang clan barely stood on their shaky legs, looking for sparring partners.
"This, this time the Twelve-Two-Wang brother is with me..."
"Huh-huck."
"What's the Six-Two-Wang brother spitting out..."
"He, hehe, butterfly, butterfly."
"Snap out of it, Nata Brother! That's not a butterfly, it's vomit."
In the brutal scene that was indistinguishable between training and torture, Ban and Boras looked down at Jin, who had fallen.
"Less than 10 rampages over the past two days... With this, it seems like we can slowly start. How does it look to you, Tushin Brother?"
"That seems right. The chaos that is slowly consuming Brother Jin must be getting tired, so please prepare. Training is over! Brothers, take your seats."
Finally, the Myung-Wang clan awkwardly took their seats as if they had survived, and Boras pulled the chaos extraction assistant device in front of Jin.
The machine was pillar-shaped, and when Boras pressed a button, seams opened and chair-like and belt-like things popped out all over.
Boras sat the wilted Jin on the chair and tied the straps around his head. Like the training, it also looked like a scene of torture.
Then Ban put her hand on Jin's heart of light.
At that, the heart of light emitted a blinding light like a waterfall, and Jin felt his mind clear instantly.
"Are you back to your senses, Brother Jin."
"I thought I was in the afterlife, but luckily, it seems I'm still alive. Tushin Brother."
"We're about to extract your chaos now."
"How... Oh."
"Swoosh!"
Suddenly, Ban's hand dug into Jin's heart. Thanks to some treatment by Ban, the heart was as soft as mud.
'Insane... so extraction means physically taking it out. It's even more dangerous than when Yona temporarily extracted the chaos from Amela.'
Ban rummaged through the heart as if searching for something hidden, grabbing the chaotic energy hidden within.
The sensation of her grabbing the chaos was very clear. And so was the fear 'felt by the chaos.'
"......As expected, the condition is not good."
"Do you think the side effects will be worse than you thought, Tushin Brother?"
"We have to hope not."
Thump!
Strength flowed into Ban's hand. Like suppressing a beast by grabbing its neck, she grabbed somewhere in the chaos.
And the moment Jin was about to ask something more.
"Khaaaa...!"
Ban started to pull her hand out of the heart, and immediately, a scream of chaos was heard.
'It sounds like the voice of the Demon Stone, Gliac. I can't believe I'm hearing this horrible sound again.'
If his brothers weren't there, Jin would have been overwhelmed by a tremendous pressure as soon as he heard the scream. The Black Emperor's War was Jin's worst nightmare.
However, while the Demon Stone and Gliac had given everyone despair with just their voices, now it was the opposite.
"Kaak, Khaak!"
The scream of chaos was filled with a sense of desperation rather than dignity, almost pleading 'save me.'
"Kiiii, Khaak!"
Soon, a part that seemed to be the 'head' of the chaos popped out from the heart. That head, crushed by Ban's grip, was rolling its eyes ceaselessly. It didn't dare to meet Ban's eyes.
"Come out quietly... if you want to disappear with a little less pain."

Amazingly, from that moment on, the chaos stopped making noise. Instead, it showed an attitude of perfect submission to Ban, enduring the pain with its eyes tightly closed. Just like how Amela's chaos was afraid of Yona.
When more than half of the chaos had come out, Jin was first surprised by how huge its form was......
Jin had no choice but to be greatly shocked by the fact that what was being drawn out from his body was not just chaos.
Energy.
The energy that Jin had accumulated throughout his life as a demon swordsman was also being drawn out, mixed with chaos.
"Ban, my energy is being mixed into the chaos...!"
As if he knew, Ban nodded and completely extracted the chaos.
Thud! Thump!

Although Ban had only plucked it out like digging up a sweet potato root, the chaos, disoriented, possessed a huge body size almost comparable to that of Murakan in its original form. Its shape was similar to a dragon.
And as soon as it got out, it fell flat towards Ban, indicating that it had no will to fight.
"Khek, kiiiing...."
"Oh, fortunately, it was extracted in one go. It seems there are almost no side effects, so if the Tushin brothers suppress it..."
"It seems I didn't hear Jin's words because I was messing with the device. The side effect is loss, Otuwang brothers."
Upon hearing the words of Ban about loss of power, Boras touched his forehead.
"Loss? Not rampage, erosion, or transformation?"
"Yes."
"Damn."
Even during the conversation, the chaos kept looking around.
"So Ban can't handle it instead of Jin..."
Ban locked eyes with Jin.
"Jin will have to fight it directly from now on."
"......All my power has been taken by that thing, Tushin brothers."
"So the only one who can deal with it is Jin. If I handle it, your energy will have to disappear along with it. You have to fight and recover it."
Upon hearing this, the chaos immediately understood the situation and smirked. It instantly realized that Jin was Ban's 'weakness'.
